name: Best Buy
outlook:
What Best Buy says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: comparable sales and marginThe company expects Q3 FY27 comparable sales to be in the range of 1.0% to 3.0% and adjusted operating income rate to be in the range of 4.1% to 4.2%.
  • Fiscal 2027: share repurchasesThe company expects to spend approximately $300 million on share repurchases during FY27.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
